data.name: Photoelectric Cloak
data.description: A gadget that allows the user to conceal themselves from ARC.
data.article:
The Photoelectric Cloak is a gadget that lets you temporarily hide from ARCs. When you use it, ARCs will lose sight of you, even if you were already fighting them. While cloaked, you can only move slowly. The cloak uses energy, which is shown by a meter on your screen. This energy slowly refills once the cloak is no longer active, even if you put it away. Using the cloak consumes a small amount of energy immediately, so it is often better to use it for longer periods rather than short bursts.

You can craft this item at a Utility Station. It can also be obtained as a reward from specific projects, such as the Trophy Display (Stage 2) or Raider Deck AR/RD 002: Goalie (Page 4). Additionally, it can be recycled to recover materials.

data.name: Pilgrim's Peak Security Code
data.description: Temporary security code to unlock the main gate.
data.flavor_text: Can only be used during Locked Gate
data.article:
The Pilgrim's Peak Security Code is a temporary code used to unlock a main gate on the Blue Gate map. It is essential for opening a specific gate during a 'Locked Gate' map condition, as you need four different codes to fully unlock it.

You can find this code inside any lootable container within the Pilgrim's Peak location on the Blue Gate map. At least one code typically appears during a round, and you might find more. To use the code, proceed to the Gate Control Room on the Blue Gate map, enter the building, and submit it at one of the four terminals. Submitting a code consumes it and activates the terminal which helps to open the Locked Gate.
